{{Quote|The Zarracines refused to accommodate Coruscant's envoys and on the verge of capture the entire ruling council killed themselves to avoid conversion and spite their conquerors. In retaliation, Commodore Daymont "Veracity" Praji bombed Zarracina III into radioactive winter.|Dr. Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="Tinker" />}}
'''Zarracina III''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Zarracina sector/Legends|Zarracina sector]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Zarracine]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. When a stable [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump point was discovered in the [[Zarracina system/Legends|Zarracina system]] in [[11,660 BBY]], the [[Pius Dea]]&ndash;controlled [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] attempted to acquire Zarracina III.

However, the Zarracines rejected Republic [[Envoy/Legends|envoys]], and their entire [[Zarracina III ruling council|ruling council]] committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]] when the Republic attempted to conquer the planet. In response, Zarracina III was subjected to an [[Bombardment of Zarracina III|orbital bombardment]] that devastated the planet and forced the few surviving Zarracines to adopt a nomadic existence.

==Description==
Zarracina III was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that occupied the third [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position in the [[Zarracina system/Legends|Zarracina system]],<ref name="Tinker" /> a part of the [[Zarracina sector/Legends|Zarracina sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="Trailing Sectors" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
{{Quote|But long before the end, in 11,660 BBY, a stable hyperspace jump point was discovered in the Zarracina system, and acquiring its inhabited third planet became a priority for the Republic.|Dr. Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="Tinker" />}}
[[File:Twelfth_Pius_Dea_Crusade.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The Zarracina system became a target of the Twelfth Pius Dea Crusade.]]
In [[11,660 BBY]], a stable [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump point was discovered in the Zarracina [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Due to the discovery's strategic nature, acquiring the inhabited Zarracina III became a priority for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which was under the control of the [[Speciesism|speciesist]] [[Pius Dea]] cult at the [[Time/Legends|time]]. When the [[Zarracine]]s, the native [[Species/Legends|species]] of Zarracina III, rejected envoys from<ref name="Tinker" /> the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Republic initiated a [[Twelfth Pius Dea Crusade|crusade]] against the natives of the Zarracina system.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> On the verge of capture by the Republic, the entire [[Zarracina III ruling council|ruling council]] of Zarracina III committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]] in order to avoid conversion to the Pius Dea religion and to spite the would-be Republic conquerors.<ref name="Tinker" />

In response, Republic [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] [[Daymont Praji]] ordered the [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of Zarracina III, which sent the planet into a state of [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] [[Winter/Legends|winter]]. The [[Bombardment of Zarracina III|bombardment]] also caused the [[Speciecide|near-extinction]] of the Zarracines, with the few remaining [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] adopting a nomadic existence and nurturing hatred for the Republic&mdash;which subsequently annexed the Zarracina system&mdash;and the [[House Praji/Legends|Praji family]] that lasted for more than ten [[Millennium/Legends|thousand years]]. In [[104 ABY]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gabrel Treon]] mentioned the bombardment of Zarracina III in the article "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes]]," published in the [[Byblos Journal of Historical Science]].<ref name="Tinker" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|The Republic annexed the system and the few surviving Zarracines became a nomadic species.|Dr. Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="Tinker" />}}
Zarracina III was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] Zarracine species and was governed by a ruling council. Following the devastation of their planet, the remaining Zarracines became a nomadic species.<ref name="Tinker" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zarracina III was mentioned in "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]," an article authored by [[Nathan O'Keefe]] and published as part of the [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature on [[February 5]], [[2009]].<ref name="Tinker" /> The 2009 reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Zarracina system, and therefore Zarracina III, in grid square O-14.<ref name="TEA" />
